extracted.intended_audience: early career investigators applying for the NIH Director's New Innovator Award
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and eligibility/award standards for applicants to the NIH Director's New Innovator Award, a High‑Risk, High‑Reward program supporting early stage investigators proposing bold, highly innovative projects with potential for major impact relevant to the NIH mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for early career investigators of exceptional creativity
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of the High‑Risk, High‑Reward Research program, the award supports early career investigators of exceptional creativity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be early career researchers demonstrating exceptional creativity; see eligibility requirement for Early Stage Investigator status. The program prioritizes individuals rather than multi‑PI teams (single PI only).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bold and highly innovative research projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must propose bold and highly innovative research projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program emphasizes novel, high‑risk/high‑reward ideas rather than incremental work. No preliminary data are required, reflecting tolerance for untested but potentially transformative concepts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential to produce a major impact on broad, important areas relevant to the NIH mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed research should have the potential to produce a major impact on broad, important areas relevant to the NIH mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should target outcomes or directions that could broadly influence fields of health‑related importance rather than narrowly scoped incremental advances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early Stage Investigator (ESI) status (eligibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: Must have Early Stage Investigator status: completed doctoral degree or postgraduate clinical training within last 10 years and never received a substantial NIH independent research award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an eligibility requirement; applicants who do not meet ESI criteria are not eligible for this award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single PI only
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are accepted for a single Principal Investigator only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multi‑PI applications are not permitted for this award.

rubrics_metrics.name: No preliminary data required
rubrics_metrics.description: No preliminary data are required for the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The absence of a requirement for preliminary data signals the program's acceptance of high‑risk proposals that may not yet have supporting data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum research effort requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Award requires a minimum of 25% research effort from the PI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must commit at least one quarter of their professional effort to the proposed project during the award period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award budget and duration limits
rubrics_metrics.description: $475,000 per year for 5 years (award funding level and period).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should plan proposed budgets and project scope consistent with this funding level and duration; see the Award Overview for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program context: High‑Risk, High‑Reward emphasis
rubrics_metrics.description: The award is part of the High‑Risk, High‑Reward Research program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should align proposals with the programmatic goal of supporting unusually innovative, potentially transformative research that carries higher risk than traditional funding mechanisms.
